A '''breakthrough armor company''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
The company was comprised of just four [[armor platoon]]s and a command tank, as the company's support element was attached to [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] headquarters and did not travel with the company. Depending on the configuration, a breakthrough armor company numbered between twenty-one and thirty-seven tanks. A breakthrough armor company's mission profile was to penetrate enemy lines to destroy assets or seize contested zones until balanced forces could reinforce them. With no support element, the pressure on the company was considerable as supplies and parts had to be carried with the company.<ref name="ISB" />

A breakthrough armor company could be augmented with four additional [[armor platoon]]s.<ref name="ISB2" />
